summary:
• Gemini 4 Argon — Google DeepMind's new large model with a million‑token window, enabling whole‑codebase reasoning and complex multi‑step tasks.
• Claude Code — Anthropic's coding assistant update adds UI shortcuts, in‑session GitHub API calls, and prompt recovery to streamline debugging.
• AI System Design — a community‑curated repository that provides runnable notebooks and Docker configs for building production‑grade LLM, RAG, and agent pipelines.
• Strands Decider — a lightweight decision‑model library that strips the generation head from a decoder LLM, delivering millisecond‑scale scored choices for real‑time pipelines.
• Meta’s Muse Gadgets — open‑source firmware and Linux SDK let developers attach Meta’s personal AI assistant to cheap hardware, creating custom voice‑controlled peripherals.
• GPT‑6 model guide — a concise playbook that consolidates community best practices for selecting variants, tuning reasoning depth, and safely orchestrating tool calls.
